intelligence.enrichment: Adequate water and direct sunlight together support better plant growth; absence of water can cause death, and absence of sunlight reduces growth even when water is present. Similar saplings with sunlight and adequate water -> better growth; sunlight without water or water without sunlight -> reduced growth or death. The learner correctly applies this rule: Adequate water and direct sunlight together support better plant growth; absence of water can cause death, and absence of sunlight reduces growth even when water is present. A watered plant should grow best even in the dark because watering plants regularly makes them grow.
